_notes.usage: Copy the fields you need into config/floofclaw_config.json; keys beginning with an underscore are explanatory and ignored by the runtime.
_notes.bot_name: The bot's user-facing name and gateway process label.
_notes.default_floop: The floop used when a command does not pass --floop.

_notes.host: Local bind address for the gateway WebSocket listener.

_notes.cross_context_read: When true, agents may see active affairs from other conversation contexts.

manage_codex._allowed_project_root_note: Optional absolute existing directory. Only calls with root=project use it; workspace remains the default.

_notes.enabled: Expose the authenticated loopback local-client listener: GET /v1/health, /v1/pulse, /v1/usage and the chat upgrade.
_notes.path: HTTP path used for the FloofClawWS 1.0 upgrade. Provision its token with: fclaw auth set-stdin local_client_api.

_notes.enabled: Connect the IRC adapter when the gateway starts.
_notes.server: IRC server hostname; irc.libera.chat is a public example.
_notes.port: Use 6697 for TLS or 6667 for plaintext unless the network documents another port.
_notes.tls: Encrypt the IRC connection. TLS requires OpenSSL support in the build.
_notes.realname: IRC real-name field shown by WHOIS.
_notes.require_mention_in_channel: When true, channel messages must mention the bot nick; direct messages are unaffected.
_notes.ops_channel: Default IRC destination for proactive messages.

_notes.enabled: Connect the Discord adapter when the gateway starts.
_notes.debug: Print additional Discord adapter diagnostics to stderr.
_notes.allow_bots: Accept messages authored by other bots. Leave false for normal installs.
_notes.allow_dms: Accept direct messages to the bot.
_notes.require_mention_in_guild: When true, guild messages must mention the bot.
_notes.guild_id: Discord server ID from Developer Mode.
_notes.allowed_channel_ids: Guild channel IDs the bot is allowed to read and answer in.
_notes.token_key: Auth-store key containing the Discord bot token; this is a key name, never the token itself.
_notes.home_channel_id: Destination for proactive messages; when absent, delivery falls back to allowed_channel_ids[0].
